target: Spoiler-free 100% completion of all five included Greek-era games on the selected PS3 package route

areas.name: Collection and Remaster Setup
areas.location_cue: The PS3 Saga package, its disc selectors, download-entitlement history, and five separate save-data groups.
areas.note: Three games are disc components; the two PSP remasters depend on historical download ownership.

levels.1: The selected route is the five-game PS3 bundle.
levels.2: Use original PS3 package media or a lawful RPCS3 disc workflow.
levels.3: Install both discs, create separate save groups for every component, and keep the package version free of gameplay-altering patches.

levels.1: The package's disc content should expose three campaigns.
levels.2: Confirm the first, second, and third mainline games launch.
levels.3: Start each disc component, reach its title menu, create a save, exit normally, and verify all three save-data groups remain separate.

levels.1: Historical voucher ownership controls the two portable remasters.
levels.2: Check the PSN account download history for both Origins titles.

levels.1: Every included game keeps independent persistent unlocks.
levels.2: Use a distinct save and backup label for each component.
levels.3: Create five named backup sets and preserve each game's clear data, challenges, costumes, replay modes, treasures, and bonus menus without overwriting another component.

areas.name: God of War (2005) Component
areas.location_cue: The God of War (2005) entry in the package selector and its own load, challenge, and bonus menus.
areas.note: All gameplay requirements live in the verified standalone `god-of-war-2005` pack.

levels.1: Treat this included title as a complete standalone project.
levels.3: Complete the standalone God of War (2005) pack in full, including its campaign clears, finite collectibles, upgrades, difficulty-gated rewards, challenges, secrets, and post-clear menus. Preserve its completed save separately.

items.label: Verify God of War (2005) Clear Data

levels.1: Return to the package selector only after its persistent unlocks are saved.
levels.2: Reload the completed component and inspect its post-clear menus.
levels.3: Load the completed God of War (2005) data, open every challenge, replay, costume, treasure, arena, or bonus menu used by its standalone pack, exit normally, then reload once to confirm persistence.
